body.name: assignment-law-averaged information scale
body.construction: For each realized history use \(\mathsf G_{\mathcal D}(v;H)\) as displayed in the symbol table, and set \(\overline{\mathsf V}_{\mathcal D,\gamma}(v)=\sup_{Y\in\mathcal Y_{M,\gamma}}\mathbb E_{\mathcal D,Y}[\mathsf G_{\mathcal D}(v;H)]\). The expectation uses the actual history probabilities and actual predictable propensities.
